title: 1952 Topps Wings Friend or Foe #120 MiG-9 Russian Fighter Vintage Card R707-4
descriptionText:
1952 Topps Wings "Friend or Foe" (R707-4), card #120 - MIG-9, Russian Fighter. Front has the classic painted artwork of the twin-jet MiG-9 in flight. The back carries the stat block, the write-up about the MiG-9 "Fargo," the Jr. Skywatcher Quiz silhouette (Answer: Shooting Star - US) and the "Earn Your Wings - Join the Ground Observer Corps" panel.

Condition: Very Good to Excellent for a card over 70 years old. Artwork is bright and clean with light corner and edge wear; the back is clean and fully legible. No creases, tears or writing found. Please review both photos - they are of the actual card you will receive.

Ships in a penny sleeve and top loader.
